AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.

16. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Digestive systems of animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Parasite control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
